Gas6 inhibits apoptosis by activating the Axl receptor tyrosine, which in turn activates PI3K, leading to activation of Akt.

Gas6-Axl signaling is an important survival pathway in vascular smooth muscle cells that is activated in the setting of vascular injury.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Gas6, a growth factor for VSMC, inhibits apoptosis in VSMC by activation of the Axl-PI3-Kinase-Akt pathway.

Axl is a pro-survival receptor that is activated by the ligand Gas6, which binds to the Axl extracellular region.
